about.pageDescription: Learn about Davi Giroux, building AI-powered solutions for a leading crypto exchange while pursuing entrepreneurship and sharing the journey.

hero.description: After years building software for companies like PagSeguro and Riot Games, I'm now working on AI-powered marketing infrastructure for one of the world's leading crypto exchanges (top 3 globally). When I'm not coding, you'll find me with my family (my wife, our 1-year-old son, and Frodo, our dog) or out running. I'm passionate about the best of both worlds: working at a top company while building my own products on the side.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.description: From corporate engineering to building products

content.education: Built systems for government programs and public health at companies like Digix and Netsolar. Worked at PagSeguro PagBank on marketplace and delivery management, gaining full-stack experience with React, TypeScript, and C#. Completed a UX Design postgraduate degree during this time.
content.bigCompany: At X-Team, I worked for two major clients: first building a retirement plan management system for companies, then developing internal tools for Riot Games (game deployment and developer platforms). Worked with Golang, React, TypeScript, Azure, and AWS, always focused on creating user-friendly platforms for non-technical users.
content.transition: Joined a leading crypto exchange (top 3 globally) as Senior Software Engineer. Shifted focus to AI-powered solutions and marketing infrastructure while starting to pursue entrepreneurship alongside full-time work.
content.current: Building AI-powered marketing platforms for one of the world's leading crypto exchanges, working with Golang, React, MongoDB, Snowflake, and AI tools like Claude, GPT-4, and Gemini. Pursuing entrepreneurship by building my own products while working full-time, and sharing everything I learn through this blog.

mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.subtitle: Why I'm doing this
mission.content: After working at companies like PagSeguro, Riot Games (via X-Team), and now one of the world's leading crypto exchanges, I've learned a lot about building software at scale. But I'm passionate about more than just working for others—I want to build my own products too. This blog is where I share that journey: building AI-powered marketing solutions for a top 3 crypto exchange, pursuing entrepreneurship on the side, and everything I'm learning about development, finance, and balancing it all while being a husband, father, and runner.
